card: Adds newly standardized BIP 174 test vectors covering invalid value sizes and sighash combinations to the functional test suite. Updates the PSBT combiner test runner to run vectors in both forward and reversed input orders, verifying commutative behavior in `combinepsbt`. The vectors and order requirements are drawn directly from BIP 174 updates in bitcoin/bips#1971 and bitcoin/bips#2275.
evidence: Adds test vectors specified in BIP 174 PRs bitcoin/bips#2275 (sighash combiner) and bitcoin/bips#1971 (invalid value size)
PR description: 'https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/pull/2275 additionally requires _existing_ `Combine` vectors to run in both orders, so we do that here too.'
problem: The functional test suite is missing newer test vectors from BIP 174 updates covering invalid field values and combiner handling, and does not test that `combinepsbt` produces identical results regardless of input order.

risk.why: Touches only functional test scripts and test data files.

summary: Adds new BIP 174 test vectors for an invalid value size and a sighash combiner to the functional PSBT test suite. Updates the combiner test runner in `rpc_psbt.py` to evaluate all combiner vectors in both forward and reverse order.
